summary: Independent Q6 inspection finds a real but small event-time session kernel (CLI → ingest → pipeline → watermark/journal/open-session state). Honest reachable runtime/config is ~1,600 substantive lines (~1,549 Python from src.cli plus schema/config/entrypoint); even all Python plus schema stays ~2,000, well under the large_system_strict >=3,000 floor. Validator substantive_loc=14875 is dominated by generated sql/seed.sql (12,832 INSERT/value lines) plus a duplicate 12,000-row JSONL ledger that process_events never reads. PADDING_RISK is HIGH, so this cannot PASS.

evidence.observation: Q6 independently judges whether the solver-visible core is complex, reachable, coupled, non-toy, and non-padded. For large_system_strict, >=3,000 substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is necessary but not sufficient; Complexity Governor or authenticity-validator PASS is not a Q6 verdict.

Required method: entrypoints, reachability, distinct module responsibilities, clone/wrapper/constant-shell checks, cross-module invariants, ~25% removal test, data volume vs consuming logic, and separation of generated/vendor/comment noise. PASS needs >=3,000 honest reachable LOC and no HIGH toy/padding risk.

Count only implementation that materially participates in the claimed operational system. Generated data volume is not authored code complexity. Dead/unreachable/unnecessary modules and construction toward the 3,000 floor via filler are authenticity defects. Seed SQL INSERT dumps are stateful data, not runtime/config LOC.
Software/Systems Python streaming task; artifacts [/app/sessions]; separate verifier; workdir /app; public network. Does not encode the LOC floor; strict profile is bound from the design report only.
Design report records profile=large_system_strict and task_kind=software. Used only to bind the strict LOC/padding gate, not as a copied complexity or authenticity verdict.

Complexity gate prints substantive_loc=14875 and PASS. Largest file listed is environment/sessions/sql/seed.sql at 12832 lines. Q6 treats this as evidence to discount: naive .sql counting of generated INSERT rows is not honest runtime/config LOC. This run is not copied as a Q6 PASS.
Operator entrypoint exports PYTHONPATH and execs python3 -m src.cli. Real workflow root, not a stub.

Primary CLI (~83 substantive lines): argparse for --input/--feed/--reset-output/--empty-check, load_config, load_state, read_events, order_for_mode, process_events, persist_desk. Mutates journal/outputs before parse in starter form. Does not iterate warehouse/click_ledger.jsonl or catalog.sqlite as the event source.

Core loop (~73 LOC) couples SessionStore, WatermarkTrack, classify_lateness, decide_on_time_close, emit_closed_session, append_watermark, watermark_close_candidates, save_open. This is genuine streaming orchestration, but it is a single short loop—not a 3,000-line production plane.
session_key discards tenant_id (_ = tenant_id) and returns ('*', user_id). Four-line constant shell; a planted identity defect, not module depth.
WatermarkTrack.record assigns max_observed_event_time_ms = event_time_ms without max(); observe_max exists but is unused. Thin wrapper around time.watermark helpers.
Gap/duration predicates plus arrival_gap_exceeded using synthetic = arrival_index * 1000. Real branching exists, but each function is a one-line comparison.
append_journal write_text-replaces the file with seq hardcoded to 1. load_journal exists for restart. Persistence is real but shallow.

persist_desk is the only CLI path into catalog/inventory/coverage, ledger fingerprint, reconcile health, and metrics rates. It writes a last-run JSON sidecar. Warehouse queries do not feed process_events, session keys, watermarks, or journal seq.

bursty_users/channel_kind_matrix/ingest_batch_volume/plan_mix/idle_span_ms are cloned connect-SELECT-dict wrappers (~104 LOC). Only a truncated coverage_report subset is copied into the metrics sidecar.
inventory_snapshot plus tenant_user_coverage (~105 LOC). kind_time_bounds is never called from the CLI closure. Largest Python files are catalog query shells, not session semantics.
iter_ledger/ledger_stats/slice_ledger (~69 LOC) are not in the AST import closure of src.cli. Unreachable from the operator entrypoint.
event_time_ms/arrival_is_not_event_time (~8 LOC) are unused by the CLI import closure.

Build-time generator (~165 LOC) emits 40 tenants × 15 users × 20 events = 12,000 click rows, writes click_ledger.jsonl, writes sql/seed.sql as INSERT dumps, then loads schema+seed into catalog.sqlite. This is a seed factory, not processor runtime/config. Excluded from honest LOC.

12,832 lines / ~1.4 MiB generated by generate_seed.py: BEGIN; 40 tenant INSERTs, 40 ingest_batch INSERTs, 600 click_user INSERTs, 150 batched click_event INSERT headers plus 12,000 value tuples, COMMIT. Homogeneous templated rows (t00–t39, u000–u014, cycling kinds/channels). Not authored runtime/config; counting it as substantive_loc is padding.
Honest runtime schema (~50 substantive lines) for tenant/click_user/ingest_batch/click_event/processor_run. Counts as config structure. Far too small to close the LOC floor.
12,000 JSONL rows, the same generated events as seed.sql. Processor CLI reads --input/--feed fixtures, not this ledger. Data volume without consuming session logic.
Three integer knobs (session_gap_ms, allowed_lateness_ms, max_session_duration_ms). Honest config, five lines.
Pinned Python image copies sessions/, runs generate_seed.py at build, chmod on run-sessions. Operator packaging is real; it does not enlarge processor logic.
Incident note describes tenant-key collision, watermark rewind, journal seq=1, --reset-output wiping the journal. Supports a real work package, not LOC scale.

Independent inventory excluding comments/blanks: environment .py 1,963 (src 1,798 across 64 files; generate_seed 165). AST import closure from src.cli reaches 45 Python files / 1,549 substantive lines. Not in closure: ledger.catalog (69), ledger.histogram (24), time.event_clock (8), plus package __init__ re-exports. schema.sql 50 + processor.json 5 + run-sessions 5. Honest reachable runtime/config ≈ 1,609. Upper bound counting unused Python + seed generator + schema ≈ 2,023. seed.sql 12,832 and click_ledger.jsonl 12,000 excluded as generated data. Average src file ≈ 28 substantive lines; many public helpers (kind_time_bounds, observe_max, peek_raw, EventTimeTimers.clear/due unused except via sync_from_store, ledger.catalog, etc.) are never productively called from the operator path.

findings.why_it_matters: Profile is large_system_strict. Honest reachable Python from src.cli is 1,549 substantive lines; adding schema.sql, processor.json, and run-sessions still ≈1,609. Even counting unused src modules and generate_seed.py stays ≈2,023. That is below the 3,000 floor. The session kernel is real but small; scale is not present in runtime/config implementation.
findings.minimal_remediation: Grow solver-visible reachable domain logic that entrypoints actually execute (event-time assignment, watermark/journal/recovery, tenant isolation, ingest/validation, operator workflows) until honest substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is >=3,000 without counting generated INSERT/JSONL dumps.
findings.regression_risk: Medium: added reachable logic must remain deterministic and aligned with the public session contract; do not bulk-add comments, clones, or unused packages.

findings.criterion: generated SQL/data dumps are not counted as runtime/config implementation
findings.why_it_matters: Complexity validator reports substantive_loc=14875 and PASS because .sql lines are counted. 12,832 of those lines are generate_seed.py output: templated INSERT INTO tenant/ingest_batch/click_user/click_event. That is generated stateful data, not authored processor or config logic. Treating the validator PASS as production depth would rubber-stamp padding.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep seed.sql as deterministic data if the domain needs 10k–20k records, but do not use it to satisfy the runtime/config LOC floor. Honest implementation must live in reachable code/schema that participates in operator behavior.
findings.regression_risk: Low for removing the LOC-credit of seed.sql; high if someone deletes the warehouse without replacing authentic stateful scale where the processor actually consumes it.

findings.criterion: data/state volume must be consumed by domain logic branches, not sit beside a fixture-driven kernel
findings.why_it_matters: 12,000 warehouse events and catalog.sqlite exist, but run-sessions processes --input/--feed files. Catalog snapshots appear only inside persist_desk last-run metrics. Removing the warehouse would not change session closes, lateness classification, or journal seq. Data volume is disconnected from consuming logic.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either make the operator workflow ingest/reconcile warehouse or catalog records with session/watermark/tenant branches that depend on that variation, or stop presenting the dump as production runtime scale.
findings.regression_risk: Medium: wiring the ledger as a live feed changes observed outputs and must stay deterministic; do not special-case fixture filenames.

findings.criterion: no micro-module, unused-helper, or clone-wrapper inflation of the production surface
findings.why_it_matters: 64 src files average ~28 substantive lines. catalog/coverage and inventory are cloned SQLite SELECT wrappers; runtime/checkpoint wraps journal+snapshot; several public functions have no productive callers from src.cli (ledger.catalog, event_clock, kind_time_bounds, observe_max, peek_raw, and others). File count and sidecar queries inflate the appearance of a large system around a short pipeline.
findings.minimal_remediation: Delete or actually wire unused modules/helpers. Keep catalog/ops only if they change operator-visible processing or recovery. Prefer deepening session/watermark/journal/ingest paths over adding more one-function packages.
findings.regression_risk: Low if unused files are removed; medium if catalog queries are promoted into the processing path without a contract.

Wire warehouse/catalog into consuming session/watermark logic or stop using them as production-scale evidence.
Remove or runtime-wire unused modules (ledger.catalog, time.event_clock, unused helpers) and collapse clone query shells.
Re-run Q6 after environment/task.toml scope changes; review_scope_hash will change.
do_not_change: Q6 is read-only: do not edit instruction.md, tests/, solution/, or environment/ on the strength of this reviewer chat.
Do not treat Complexity Governor PASS (substantive_loc=14875) or any authenticity-validator PASS as a Q6 PASS.
Do not count sql/seed.sql, warehouse/click_ledger.jsonl, or generate_seed.py output volume as substantive runtime/config LOC.
Do not copy other specialist verdicts, prior Q6 results, or a desired difficulty tier over this inspection.
Do not weaken the verifier or instruction to dodge the production-logic floor.
next_gate: Route Q6_REVISE to System Architect / Environment Builder to replace generated-SQL LOC inflation with honest reachable runtime/config depth (>=3,000) and consume or stop padding with warehouse dumps. Regenerate the Q6 packet/result for the new review_scope_hash. Quality Interlock cannot PASS on this Q6 REVISE.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Keying snapshots with tenant_id while session_key still returns ('*', user_id) keeps cross-tenant merges.
Clamping comparison watermark at 0 without max() on record() still rewinds max_observed on a late event.
Incrementing seq in memory while append_journal write_text-replaces the file still loses history.
Disabling arrival_gap entirely can look correct on one --input fixture and fail event-time gap closes.
Rejecting unknown flags after --reset-output has already truncated the journal still loses restart state.
Writing catalog metrics without changing lookup/watermark/journal leaves warehouse padding untouched.
Deleting seed.sql without adding reachable processor depth still fails the 3,000 floor—and counting seed.sql as the fix is the padding defect.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of the load-bearing kernel (cli parse + pipeline loop + ingest decoder + journal/snapshot + lateness/windows rules) would collapse session closes, late.jsonl, and restart. Separately, removing sql/seed.sql (12,832 lines), click_ledger.jsonl (12,000 rows), catalog/coverage+inventory query clones, ops.desk warehouse sidecar, and unused ledger.catalog/event_clock would leave process_events outputs unchanged. The bulk of measured environment volume fails the 25% removal test; only a ~1.5k-line kernel is load-bearing.
REQUIRED_CHANGES: Replace generated-SQL LOC inflation with honest reachable runtime/config implementation until substantive reachable LOC is >=3,000.
Make warehouse/catalog records drive session/watermark/tenant logic, or treat them as data-only and stop using them for production-scale claims.
Delete or wire unused modules/helpers and collapse clone SELECT wrappers that do not change operator behavior.
Re-issue Q6 on the updated review_scope_hash after environment changes.
